firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently gave someone flowers (or a skull) is the first player.
houseFallback: If nobody qualifies, choose randomly. If the most recent gift is tied, choose randomly among the tied players.
clarifications: Before turns begin, everyone places a disc facedown. The first player waits until the others have placed theirs before choosing their own. Turns then proceed clockwise.
In later rounds, the previous Challenger starts unless eliminated. If eliminated by another player’s skull, its owner starts; after self-elimination, the Challenger chooses the next starter.
